Requests enter through Cloudflare and an AWS Application Load Balancer before reaching microservices running on Amazon EKS.
The Order Service manages order creation and status.
The Restaurant Service handles restaurant availability and menu updates, while the Dispatch Service assigns delivery partners.
PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS stores order and payment records.
Redis caches restaurant menus and courier locations.
Amazon MSK carries order and delivery events between services, and Amazon SQS handles delayed notification jobs.
Courier GPS updates arrive through an API and are processed by the Tracking Service before the latest location is stored in Redis and displayed to customers.
Terraform manages infrastructure.

- Demand increases significantly during weekends and dinner hours.
- Avoid production deployments during major promotional campaigns.
